title: Climate Chain Unified Historical Dataset Registry
audit_statement: Independent dataset audit conducted under IEEE ClimateChain guidelines. Counts represent distinct cataloged datasets; observation record counts reflect validated historical data rows.

datasets.official_title: NOAA NCEI / NASA GISS Global Surface Temperature Anomaly (GISTEMP v4)
datasets.source_agency: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) / NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies
datasets.data_license: U.S. Public Domain / Open Government Data
datasets.uncertainty_method: 95% confidence interval including spatial coverage and urban heat island adjustments (Hansen et al., 2010)
datasets.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. Lenssen et al., 2019, J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., 124, 6307-6326.

datasets.official_title: Law Dome Ice Core (Etheridge et al.) and NOAA Mauna Loa Keeling Atmospheric CO2 Record
datasets.source_agency: Australian Antarctic Division (AAD) / NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML)
datasets.access_method: NOAA GML REST / WDC Paleoclimatology Archives
datasets.uncertainty_method: Ice core gas enclosure age distribution ±5 yr; Mauna Loa flask and continuous analyzer precision ±0.12 ppm
datasets.citation: Etheridge, D.M. et al. (1996), J. Geophys. Res., 101(D2), 4115-4128; Tans, P. and Keeling, R. (2026), NOAA/GML Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide.

datasets.official_title: Historical Atmospheric Methane (CH4) Concentration from Law Dome Ice Cores and NOAA GML Network
datasets.source_agency: CSIRO Oceans and Atmosphere / NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory
datasets.uncertainty_method: WMO X2004A methane mole fraction scale repeatability ±0.8 ppb
datasets.citation: MacFarling Meure, C. et al. (2006), Geophys. Res. Lett., 33, L14810; Dlugokencky, E.J. (2026), Atmospheric Methane Dry Air Mole Fractions from the NOAA GML Carbon Cycle Cooperative Global Air Sampling Network.

datasets.official_title: High-Resolution Point-Source Methane Plume Detections over the Permian Basin (TX/NM)
datasets.source_agency: Carbon Mapper / NASA JPL Airborne Visible/Infrared Imaging Spectrometer
datasets.data_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / Public Research Release
datasets.access_method: Carbon Mapper API Snapshot / GeoJSON GZ
datasets.uncertainty_method: Wind speed retrieval uncertainty 20-35%; Minimum Detection Limit ~50-100 kg/hr at 3 m/s wind speed (Cusworth et al., 2021)
datasets.citation: Duren, R.M. et al. (2019), Nature, 575, 180-184; Cusworth, D.H. et al. (2021), Environ. Sci. Technol. Lett., 8(9), 739-746.

datasets.official_title: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) National Ambient Air Quality Index Time Series
datasets.source_agency: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
datasets.data_license: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) Government of India
datasets.geographic_coverage: National Capital Region (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad)
datasets.access_method: Central AQMS Real-time Stream & OpenAQ Ingest
datasets.uncertainty_method: Continuous automated baseline calibration with manual periodic reference checks
datasets.citation: CPCB Guidelines for Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring (CAAQMS), Central Pollution Control Board, New Delhi (2024).

datasets.official_title: IRENA Global Renewable Electricity Generation Share and Capacity Statistics
datasets.source_agency: International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) / Energy Institute
datasets.data_license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO)
datasets.variable: Share of Electricity from Renewable Sources
datasets.uncertainty_method: National grid accounting reconciliation; uncertainty estimated <2% for OECD, 3-5% non-OECD
datasets.citation: IRENA (2026), Renewable Energy Statistics 2026, International Renewable Energy Agency, Abu Dhabi.

datasets.official_title: Empirical REDD+ Forest Carbon Baselines and Over-Crediting Benchmark Dataset
datasets.source_agency: Quantify Earth / University of Cambridge / Nature Communications
datasets.variable: Forest Deforestation Rate and Synthetic Counterfactual Additionality
datasets.geographic_coverage: Tropical Forest REDD+ Jurisdictions (South America, Central Africa, Southeast Asia)
datasets.uncertainty_method: Synthetic control matching with leave-one-out cross validation; bootstrap confidence intervals (p < 0.01)
datasets.citation: Swinfield, T., et al. (2026). Learning lessons from over-crediting to ensure additionality in forest carbon credits. Nature Communications, 17, 2145. DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-71552-3.

datasets.official_title: Suomi NPP / NOAA-20 VIIRS Nightfire Gas Flaring Radiant Heat Observations (Niger Delta)
datasets.source_agency: NOAA Earth Observation Group (EOG) / NASA Earthdata
datasets.data_license: U.S. Public Domain / Open Government Data
datasets.variable: Flaring Radiant Heat and Volume Estimate
datasets.geographic_coverage: Niger Delta Petroleum Basins (4.0°N to 6.5°N, 5.0°E to 8.5°E)
datasets.uncertainty_method: Planck curve fit temperature threshold >1600 K; cloud obstruction and heavy rain exclusion flags applied
datasets.citation: Elvidge, C.D. et al. (2016), Remote Sensing, 8(4), 323; Methods for Global Survey of Natural Gas Flaring from VIIRS.
